pageIntro: What customers ask us most often — about sourcing, ordering and visiting the store. If your question is not here, call or WhatsApp us and we will answer it directly.

items.a: We stock staples grown and processed without synthetic pesticides or chemical fertilisers, sourced from suppliers who can account for how the produce was grown. Where a product carries a certification, the pack shows it. Where a supplier is a small local farm working organically without formal certification, we will tell you that plainly rather than blur the difference.

items.a: Three ranges. Organic groceries — millets and grains, pulses and dals, cold-pressed oils, flours and atta, spices and masalas, natural sweeteners. Natural cosmetics — skin care, hair oils and cleansers, bath essentials, body butters and balms. And Ayurvedic energy boosters — herbal tonics, Chyawanprash and lehyams, daily energy mixes, and immunity and strength support.

items.q: How are cold-pressed oils different from what I buy at a supermarket?
items.a: Cold-pressed oils are extracted by crushing the seed at low temperature, without solvent extraction or high-heat refining. They keep more of the seed's aroma, colour and natural compounds, which is why they taste distinctly of the seed they came from. They also have a shorter shelf life than refined oils — buy them in quantities you will finish in a couple of months.

items.q: Do Ayurvedic products treat medical conditions?
items.a: No. The Ayurvedic preparations we stock — Chyawanprash, lehyams, herbal tonics and daily mixes — support general wellbeing and vitality. They are not medicines, and nothing we sell is intended to diagnose, treat or cure any condition. If you are pregnant, managing a health condition, or taking prescribed medication, please speak to a qualified practitioner before adding anything new.

items.q: How long do the products keep?
items.a: Every pack carries its own manufacturing and best-before date, and that date is what you should follow. As a general guide: whole grains and pulses last longest, milled flours are best used within a few weeks, and cold-pressed oils and natural cosmetics — which carry no synthetic preservatives — have the shortest life of the three. Store everything airtight, away from sunlight and heat.
